title: Revision Request
description: Atomic revision entries for text fragments or contiguous blocks, named <complete-original-filename>.rr. Opening or changing status metadata never applies a source edit.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the VS Code workspace folder containing this .rr file. Must remain inside that folder. Use nonempty segments; . and .., Windows reserved device names, colons, backslashes, and trailing dots or spaces are rejected.

time.description: Creation time in ISO 8601 with timezone. Generators add it automatically. Missing time in hand-written requests is filled from file creation time when reviewed.

request.description: Each entry is one atomic review decision. Group only consecutive changed lines; any unchanged line, including a blank line, comment, label, or delimiter, requires separate entries regardless of shared purpose. Keep matching context within changed lines. Single-line entries are appropriate for isolated edits. Entirely added/deleted blocks may remain multiline. This is authoring guidance; supplied boundaries are preserved. Consumed original line ranges cannot overlap. Empty arrays have no pending requests.

line.description: 1-based first original line of the fragment or block. Insertions occur before this line; original line count + 1 appends. Numbers stay fixed after other entries are accepted.

before.description: Exact fragment beginning in the indicated original line, with LF separators for consecutive lines, or null to insert. Match uniquely; intervening lines are complete. Deletion requires the complete original block. CR is not allowed.

after.description: Replacement text or LF-separated block, or null to delete the complete original block. Insertion supplies complete new lines. Empty string is text/a blank line. LF is logical; saved line endings are preserved. CR is not allowed.

reason.description: Optional explanation; omit it or use an empty string when none is needed. Blank or absent keeps Why disabled with its label hidden. At most 50000 UTF-8 bytes.

status.description: New requests start pending. Accept/Ignore/Undo update this metadata; manually changing it never applies a source edit.

defaultSnippets.label: Revision Request
defaultSnippets.description: Create a pending fragment or block change; creation time is filled automatically when reviewed.
